export const WorkflowListPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { data: workflows, isLoading, isError, refetch } = useWorkflows();
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);

  const handleCreateNew = async () => {
    try {
      setCreating(true);
      const newId = await workflowService.createWorkflow();
      navigate(`/workflows/${newId}`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to create workflow', err);
      alert('Không thể tạo quy trình mới. Vui lòng thử lại!');
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background text-foreground flex flex-col">
      {/* Top Navbar */}
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 w-full border-b border-border bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md">
        <div className="container mx-auto flex h-14 max-w-7xl items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Link
              to="/"
              className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground transition-opacity hover:opacity-80"
            >
              <div className="flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-mono text-xs shadow-sm">
                FP
              </div>
              <span className="hidden sm:inline font-bold">FlowPilot</span>
            </Link>

            <span className="text-muted-foreground/40 text-sm">/</span>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground font-medium">
              <Layers className="size-3.5" />
              <span>Workflows</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Link to="/">
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="gap-1.5 text-xs">
                <Home className="size-3.5" />
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">Trang chủ</span>
              </Button>
            </Link>
            <Button
              onClick={handleCreateNew}
              disabled={creating}
              size="sm"
              className="gap-1.5 text-xs shadow-sm"
            >
              <Plus className="size-3.5" />
              <span>{creating ? 'Đang tạo...' : 'Tạo Workflow mới'}</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Main Container */}
      <main className="flex-1 container mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 py-8">
        {/* Header Hero Banner */}
        <div className="mb-8 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-border bg-muted/50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono mb-2">
              <Sparkles className="size-3 text-amber-500" />
              <span>Orchestration Dashboard</span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
              Danh sách Quy trình (Workflows)
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Quản lý các quy trình tự động hóa, mở bản thiết kế hoặc xem các phiên bản đã xuất bản để khởi chạy.
            </p>
          </div>

          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateNew}
            disabled={creating}
            className="w-fit gap-1.5 text-xs"
          >
            <Plus className="size-4" />
            <span>Tạo Workflow mới</span>
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* Content Area */}
        {isLoading && (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-center">
            <div className="size-8 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent" />
            <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Đang tải danh sách quy trình...</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {isError && (
          <Card className="border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="text-destructive text-base">Không thể tải danh sách quy trình</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Vui lòng kiểm tra xem backend API đã được khởi động và kết nối ổn định hay chưa.
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => refetch()}>
                Thử lại
              </Button>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}

        {!isLoading && !isError && (!workflows || workflows.length === 0) && (
          <Card className="border-dashed py-12 text-center">
            <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3">
              <div className="flex size-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                <WorkflowIcon className="size-6" />
              </div>
              <div className="max-w-md">
                <h3 className="text-base font-semibold">Chưa có quy trình nào</h3>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Bắt đầu tạo quy trình tự động hóa đầu tiên của bạn bằng cách nhấn nút "Tạo Workflow mới" bên dưới.
                </p>
              </div>
              <Button onClick={handleCreateNew} disabled={creating} size="sm" className="mt-2 text-xs gap-1.5">
                <Plus className="size-3.5" />
                <span>Tạo Workflow đầu tiên</span>
              </Button>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}

        {!isLoading && !isError && workflows && workflows.length > 0 && (
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow className="bg-muted/40 hover:bg-muted/40">
                  <TableHead className="w-[300px]">Tên Workflow</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Trạng thái</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">Ngày tạo</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="hidden sm:table-cell">Cập nhật gần nhất</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Hành động</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {workflows.map((wf) => (
                  <TableRow key={wf.id} className="transition-colors hover:bg-muted/30">
                    <TableCell className="font-medium">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        <div className="flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary">
                          <WorkflowIcon className="size-4" />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-semibold text-foreground text-sm hover:underline cursor-pointer" onClick={() => navigate(`/workflows/${wf.id}`)}>
                            {wf.name || 'Untitled Workflow'}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-muted-foreground truncate max-w-[200px]">
                            {wf.id}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <Badge variant="outline" className="font-mono text-[11px] uppercase">
                          {wf.status || 'DRAFT'}
                        </Badge>
                        {wf.active && (
                          <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[11px] text-emerald-700">
                            Active
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell className="hidden md:table-cell text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <Clock className="size-3" />
                        <span>{wf.createdAt ? new Date(wf.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN') : '—'}</span>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell className="hidden sm:table-cell text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      <span>{wf.updatedAt ? new Date(wf.updatedAt).toLocaleString('vi-VN') : '—'}</span>
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell className="text-right">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                        <Button
                          variant="outline"
                          size="sm"
                          className="h-8 gap-1 text-xs"
                          onClick={() => navigate(`/workflows/${wf.id}/versions`)}
                        >
                          <GitBranch className="size-3 text-primary" />
                          <span>Phiên bản (Versions)</span>
                        </Button>

                        <Button
                          size="sm"
                          className="h-8 gap-1 text-xs"
                          onClick={() => navigate(`/workflows/${wf.id}`)}
                        >
                          <span>Mở Designer</span>
                          <ArrowRight className="size-3" />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </div>
        )}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
};

import { AxiosError } from 'axios';
import { workflowApi } from '../api/workflow.api';
import type { NodeTypeDefinition } from '../models/workflow.model';
import type { PublishResult } from '../types/workflow.types';
import {
  WorkflowPublishValidationError,
  type WorkflowValidationIssue,
} from '../models/workflow-validation.model';

function isValidationIssue(value: unknown): value is WorkflowValidationIssue {
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return false;
  const issue = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  return (
    typeof issue.code === 'string' &&
    typeof issue.message === 'string' &&
    (issue.nodeId === undefined || typeof issue.nodeId === 'string') &&
    (issue.field === undefined || typeof issue.field === 'string')
  );
}

export const workflowService = {
  async createWorkflow(): Promise<string> {
    try {
      const data = await workflowApi.createWorkflow();
      return data.id;
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      throw new Error('Failed to create workflow', { cause: error });
    }
  },

  async getWorkflows(): Promise<import('../types/workflow.types').WorkflowSummary[]> {
    try {
      return await workflowApi.getWorkflows();
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      throw new Error('Failed to get workflows', { cause: error });
    }
  },

  async getDraft(id: string): Promise<unknown> {
    try {
      return await workflowApi.getDraft(id);
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      if (error instanceof AxiosError && error.response?.status === 404) {
        return {
          definition: {
            nodes: [],
            edges: [],
            viewport: { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 },
          },
        };
      }
      throw new Error('Failed to get draft', { cause: error });
    }
  },

  async saveDraft(id: string, definition: unknown): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await workflowApi.saveDraft(id, definition);
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      throw new Error('Failed to save draft', { cause: error });
    }
  },

  async publishWorkflow(id: string): Promise<PublishResult> {
    try {
      return await workflowApi.publishWorkflow(id);
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      if (
        error instanceof AxiosError &&
        error.response?.data &&
        typeof error.response.data === 'object' &&
        'message' in error.response.data
      ) {
        const response = error.response.data as Record<string, unknown>;
        const issues = Array.isArray(response.issues)
          ? response.issues.filter(isValidationIssue)
          : [];
        if (issues.length > 0) {
          throw new WorkflowPublishValidationError(
            String(response.message),
            issues,
            { cause: error },
          );
        }
        throw new Error(String(response.message), { cause: error });
      }
      throw new Error('Failed to publish workflow', { cause: error });
    }
  },

  async getNodeTypes(): Promise<NodeTypeDefinition[]> {
    try {
      return await workflowApi.getNodeTypes();
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      console.warn('Failed to get node types, returning empty array fallback:', error);
      return [];
    }
  },
};
import { apiClient } from '../../../shared/api/http-client';
import { useAuthStore } from '../../auth';
import type { NodeTypeDefinition } from '../models/workflow.model';
import type { PublishResult } from '../types/workflow.types';


export const workflowApi = {
  createWorkflow: async (): Promise<{ id: string }> => {
    const user = useAuthStore.getState().user;
    const body: { name: string; ownerId?: string } = {
      name: 'New Workflow',
    };
    if (user?.id) {
      body.ownerId = user.id;
    }

    const res = await apiClient.post<{ data: { id: string } }>(
      '/api/workflows',
      body,
    );
    return res.data.data;
  },

  getWorkflows: async (): Promise<import('../types/workflow.types').WorkflowSummary[]> => {
    const res = await apiClient.get<{ data: import('../types/workflow.types').WorkflowSummary[] }>(
      '/api/workflows',
    );
    return res.data.data;
  },

  getDraft: async (id: string): Promise<unknown> => {
    const res = await apiClient.get<{ data: unknown }>(
      `/api/workflows/${id}/draft`,
    );
    return res.data.data;
  },

  saveDraft: async (id: string, definition: unknown): Promise<void> => {
    await apiClient.put(`/api/workflows/${id}/draft`, { definition });
  },

  publishWorkflow: async (id: string): Promise<PublishResult> => {
    const res = await apiClient.post<{ data: PublishResult }>(`/api/workflows/${id}/versions`);
    return res.data.data;
  },

  getNodeTypes: async (): Promise<NodeTypeDefinition[]> => {
    const res = await apiClient.get<{ data: NodeTypeDefinition[] }>(
      '/api/node-types',
    );
    return res.data.data;
  },
};

export interface WorkflowSummary {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  status: string;
  // The Active switch: the published version listens for events.
  active?: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface PublishResult {
  versionId: string;
  versionNumber: number;
  // Present when the workflow is active: the version that listens now. With
  // `error` the new version could not listen: the previous version keeps
  // listening (active) or, when none did, the workflow was turned off.
  activation?: { active: boolean; versionId: string | null; error?: string };

import {
  Controller,
  Post,
  Get,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { CommandBus, QueryBus } from '@nestjs/cqrs';

  ApiTags,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiResponse,
  ApiParam,
  ApiBearerAuth,
} from '@nestjs/swagger';

import {
  CurrentUser,
  AuthenticatedUser,
} from '@app/auth/infrastructure/decorators/current-user.decorator';
import { CreateWorkflowCommand } from '../../application/commands/create-workflow.command';
import { PublishWorkflowCommand } from '../../application/commands/publish-workflow.command';
import { RestoreVersionCommand } from '../../application/commands/restore-version.command';
import { GetDraftStatusQuery } from '../../application/queries/get-draft-status.query';
import { CreateWorkflowDto } from './dtos/create-workflow.dto';
import { RestoreVersionDto } from './dtos/restore-version.dto';
import { WorkflowRepository } from '../../domain/repositories/workflow.repository';
import { WorkflowVersionRepository } from '../../domain/repositories/workflow-version.repository';

@ApiTags('workflows')
@Controller('api/workflows')
export class WorkflowsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly commandBus: CommandBus,
    private readonly queryBus: QueryBus,
    private readonly workflowRepo: WorkflowRepository,
    private readonly workflowVersionRepo: WorkflowVersionRepository,
  ) {}

  @Get()
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
  @ApiBearerAuth()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of workflows owned by caller' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'List of workflows returned' })
  async getWorkflows(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const workflows = await this.workflowRepo.findByOwnerId(user.id);
    return {
      success: true,
      data: workflows.map((w) => ({
        id: w.id,
        name: w.name,
        status: w.status,
        active: w.active,
        createdAt: w.createdAt,
        updatedAt: w.updatedAt,
      })),
    };
  }

  @Post(':id/versions')
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
  @ApiBearerAuth()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Publish a workflow draft to a new version' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Workflow published successfully' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 400, description: 'Validation failed' })
  async publishWorkflow(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
  ) {
    const command = new PublishWorkflowCommand(id, user.id);

    // Command handler returns { versionId, versionNumber }
    const result = await this.commandBus.execute(command);

    return {
      success: true,
      data: result,
    };
  }

  @Get(':id/versions')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of published versions of a workflow' })
  @ApiParam({ name: 'id', description: 'The workflow ID' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'List of versions returned' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: 'Workflow not found' })
  async getVersions(@Param('id') id: string) {
    const workflow = await this.workflowRepo.findById(id);
    if (!workflow) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Workflow with ID ${id} not found.`);
    }
    const versions = await this.workflowVersionRepo.findByWorkflowId(id);
    return {
      success: true,
      data: versions.map((v) => ({
        id: v.id,
        workflowId: v.workflowId,
        versionNumber: v.versionNumber,
        publishedAt: v.publishedAt,
        publishedById: v.publishedById,
      })),
    };
  }

  @Get(':id/versions/:versionId')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get a specific version of a workflow' })
  @ApiParam({ name: 'id', description: 'The workflow ID' })
  @ApiParam({ name: 'versionId', description: 'The version ID' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Version details returned' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: 'Version not found' })
  async getVersion(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Param('versionId') versionId: string,
  ) {
    const workflow = await this.workflowRepo.findById(id);
    if (!workflow) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Workflow with ID ${id} not found.`);
    }
    const version = await this.workflowVersionRepo.findById(versionId);
    if (!version || version.workflowId !== id) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Version with ID ${versionId} not found.`);
    }
    return {
      success: true,
      data: version,
    };
  }

  @Post(':id/versions/:versionId/restore')
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
  @ApiBearerAuth()
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Restore a published version into workflow draft' })
  @ApiParam({ name: 'id', description: 'The workflow ID' })
  @ApiParam({ name: 'versionId', description: 'The version ID to restore' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Version restored into draft' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 400, description: 'Invalid strategy or version' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: 'Workflow or version not found' })
  async restoreVersion(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Param('versionId') versionId: string,
    @Body() body: RestoreVersionDto,
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
  ) {
    const command = new RestoreVersionCommand(
      id,
      versionId,
      user.id,
      body.strategy,
      body.backupWorkflowName,
      body.publishComment,
    );
    const result: unknown = await this.commandBus.execute(command);

    return {
      success: true,
      data: result,
      message: 'Phiên bản đã được khôi phục vào bản nháp thành công.',
    };
  }

  @Get(':id/draft/status')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get draft status and check unpublished changes' })
  @ApiParam({ name: 'id', description: 'The workflow ID' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Draft status returned' })
  async getDraftStatus(@Param('id') id: string) {
    const query = new GetDraftStatusQuery(id);
    const result = await this.queryBus.execute(query);
    return {
      success: true,
      data: result,
    };
  }

  @Post()
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
  @ApiBearerAuth()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new workflow' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'Workflow created successfully' })
  async createWorkflow(
    @Body() body: CreateWorkflowDto,
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
  ) {
    const ownerId = body.ownerId || user.id;
    const command = new CreateWorkflowCommand(body.name, ownerId);
    const result: unknown = await this.commandBus.execute(command);
    const workflowId = result as string;

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        id: workflowId,
      },
    };
  }
}
import { Workflow } from '../entities/workflow.entity';

export abstract class WorkflowRepository {
  abstract findById(id: string): Promise<Workflow | null>;
  abstract findByOwnerId(ownerId: string): Promise<Workflow[]>;
  abstract create(workflow: Workflow): Promise<string>;
  abstract update(workflow: Workflow): Promise<void>;
}
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { WorkflowRepository } from '../../domain/repositories/workflow.repository';
import { Workflow } from '../../domain/entities/workflow.entity';
import { PrismaService } from '@app/database/prisma/prisma.service';
import { WorkflowMapper } from './mappers/workflow.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class PrismaWorkflowRepository implements WorkflowRepository {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  async findById(id: string): Promise<Workflow | null> {
    const record = await this.prisma.workflow.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!record) return null;
    return WorkflowMapper.toDomain(record);
  }

  async findByOwnerId(ownerId: string): Promise<Workflow[]> {
    const records = await this.prisma.workflow.findMany({
      where: { ownerId },
      orderBy: { updatedAt: 'desc' },
    });
    return records.map((record) => WorkflowMapper.toDomain(record));
  }

  async create(workflow: Workflow): Promise<string> {
    const created = await this.prisma.workflow.create({
      data: {
        ...(workflow.id ? { id: workflow.id } : {}),
        name: workflow.name,
        ownerId: workflow.ownerId,
        status: workflow.status,
      },
    });
    return created.id;
  }

  async update(workflow: Workflow): Promise<void> {
    await this.prisma.workflow.update({
      where: { id: workflow.id },
      data: {
        name: workflow.name,
        ownerId: workflow.ownerId,
        status: workflow.status,
        description: workflow.description,
        currentVersionId: workflow.currentVersionId,
      },
    });
  }
}
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import { WorkflowStatus } from '../enums/workflow-status.enum';

export class Workflow {
  constructor(
    public readonly id: string,
    public readonly name: string,
    public readonly ownerId: string,
    public readonly status: WorkflowStatus,
    public readonly description?: string | null,
    public currentVersionId?: string | null,
    public readonly createdAt?: Date,
    public readonly updatedAt?: Date,
    // The Active switch; changed only by the triggers module.
    public readonly active: boolean = false,
  ) {}

  static create(props: {
    id?: string;
    name: string;
    ownerId: string;
  }): Workflow {
    return new Workflow(
      props.id || randomUUID(),
      props.name,
      props.ownerId,
      WorkflowStatus.DRAFT,
    );
  }
}

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { workflowService } from '../services/workflow.service';

export const workflowKeys = {
  all: ['workflows'] as const,
  list: () => [...workflowKeys.all, 'list'] as const,

    queryKey: workflowKeys.list(),
    queryFn: () => workflowService.getWorkflows(),
  });
}

name: Backend Guidelines
description: Guidelines for NestJS backend development, following Modular Monolith, Clean Architecture, and CQRS. Trigger this when modifying, creating, or testing backend NestJS code.

# FlowPilot Backend Coding Standard (NestJS)

You must follow these rules when developing the backend:

## 1. Architecture
- **Architecture**: Modular Monolith + Clean Architecture + CQRS.
- **Layers**: 
  - `domain/`: pure TS, no frameworks (entities, interfaces).
  - `application/`: CQRS commands/queries, orchestration logic.
  - `infrastructure/`: Prisma, BullMQ, external APIs.
  - `presentation/`: HTTP controllers/resolvers.
- Dependencies go one way: `presentation -> application -> domain` and `infrastructure -> application, domain`. No inter-module domain imports.

## 2. Naming Conventions
- **Files**: kebab-case (e.g., `start-execution.handler.ts`)
- **Classes**: PascalCase (e.g., `StartExecutionHandler`)
- **Interfaces**: PascalCase, NO `I` prefix (except node/connector plugins like `INodeDefinition`).
- **Database Tables (Prisma)**: snake_case, plural (e.g., `workflow_executions`).

## 3. CQRS & Logic
- One Command/Query per file, same folder as Handler.
- Handlers contain 1 orchestration flow, domain entities/services hold business rules.
- DO NOT return domain entities directly to `presentation/`, map to DTOs.

## 4. Testing
- **Zero test code in `src/`**: All test files live exclusively in the root `test/` directory.
- **Test Structure**:
  - `test/unit/<module>/...` (`*.spec.ts`): Unit tests for Handlers, Domain Entities, Services, Mappers with 100% mocked dependencies and ports. Mirror application/domain layers 1:1.
  - `test/integration/<module>/...` (`*.integration-spec.ts`): Tests with real infrastructure (Prisma, Postgres, Redis).
  - `test/e2e/<module>/...` (`*.e2e-spec.ts`): End-to-end API tests via `supertest`.
  - `test/support/<module>/...` (`*.test-support.ts` / `*.fixture.ts`): In-memory repositories, test doubles, builders, and fixtures.
- **In-Memory Repositories**: Do NOT mock Prisma directly in business logic unit tests; implement In-Memory Repositories conforming to domain repository interfaces.
- **Execution**: Run `npm test` inside `monolith-backend/`.

## 5. General
- Exception handling: Custom domain exceptions, catch globally in presentation.
- Validation: DTOs via `class-validator`, business validation in domain services.
- Modules only export what's needed for other modules. No `forwardRef`.
import { CommandHandler, ICommandHandler } from '@nestjs/cqrs';
import { Workflow } from '../../domain/entities/workflow.entity';
import { WorkflowRepository } from '../../domain/repositories/workflow.repository';
import { WorkflowDraftRepository } from '../../domain/repositories/workflow-draft.repository';
import { WorkflowDraft } from '../../domain/entities/workflow-draft.entity';

export class CreateWorkflowCommand {
  constructor(
    public readonly name: string,
    public readonly ownerId: string,
  ) {}
}

@CommandHandler(CreateWorkflowCommand)
export class CreateWorkflowHandler implements ICommandHandler<CreateWorkflowCommand> {
  constructor(
    private readonly workflowRepo: WorkflowRepository,
    private readonly workflowDraftRepo: WorkflowDraftRepository,
  ) {}

  async execute(command: CreateWorkflowCommand): Promise<string> {
    const workflow = Workflow.create({
      name: command.name,
      ownerId: command.ownerId,
    });
    const workflowId = await this.workflowRepo.create(workflow);

    // Automatically create an empty draft for the new workflow
    const emptyDraft = WorkflowDraft.create(workflowId, {
      nodes: [],
      edges: [],
      viewport: { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 },
    });
    await this.workflowDraftRepo.upsert(emptyDraft);

    return workflowId;
  }
}
import { Workflow as PrismaWorkflow } from '@prisma/client';
import { Workflow } from '../../../domain/entities/workflow.entity';
import { WorkflowStatus } from '../../../domain/enums/workflow-status.enum';

export class WorkflowMapper {
  static toDomain(prismaWorkflow: PrismaWorkflow): Workflow {
    return new Workflow(
      prismaWorkflow.id,
      prismaWorkflow.name,
      prismaWorkflow.ownerId,
      prismaWorkflow.status as WorkflowStatus,
      prismaWorkflow.description,
      prismaWorkflow.currentVersionId,
      prismaWorkflow.createdAt,
      prismaWorkflow.updatedAt,
      prismaWorkflow.active,
    );
  }
}

Testing\r\n- **Zero test code in `src/`**: All test files live exclusively in the root `test/` directory.\r\n- **Test Structure**:\r\n  - `test/unit/<module>/...` (`*.spec.ts`): Unit tests for Handlers, Domain Entities, Services, Mappers with 100% mocked dependencies and ports. Mirror application/domain layers 1:1.\r\n  - `test/integration/<module>/...` (`*.integration-spec.ts`): Tests with real infrastructure (Prisma, Postgres, Redis).\r\n  - `test/e2e/<module>/...` (`*.e2e-spec.ts`): End-to-end API tests via `supertest`.\r\n  - `test/support/<module>/...` (`*.test-support.ts` / `*.fixture.ts`): In-memory repositories, test doubles, builders, and fixtures.\r\n- **In-Memory Repositories**: Do NOT mock Prisma directly in business logic unit tests; implement In-Memory Repositories conforming to domain repository interfaces.\r\n- **Execution**: Run `npm test` inside `monolith-backend/`.\r\n\r\n## 5. General\r\n- Exception handling: Custom domain exceptions, catch globally in presentation.\r\n- Validation: DTOs via `class-validator`, business validation in domain services.\r\n- Modules only export what's needed for other modules. import {
  Controller,
  Post,
  Get,
  Body,
  Param,
  NotFoundException,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';

import {
  ApiTags,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiResponse,
  ApiParam,
  ApiBearerAuth,
} from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '@app/auth/infrastructure/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import {
  CurrentUser,
  AuthenticatedUser,
} from '@app/auth/infrastructure/decorators/current-user.decorator';
import { CreateWorkflowCommand } from '../../application/commands/create-workflow.command';
import { PublishWorkflowCommand } from '../../application/commands/publish-workflow.command';
import { RestoreVersionCommand } from '../../application/commands/restore-version.command';
import { GetDraftStatusQuery } from '../../application/queries/get-draft-status.query';
import { CreateWorkflowDto } from './dtos/create-workflow.dto';
import { RestoreVersionDto } from './dtos/restore-version.dto';
import { WorkflowRepository } from '../../domain/repositories/workflow.repository';
import { WorkflowVersionRepository } from '../../domain/repositories/workflow-version.repository';

@ApiTags('workflows')
@Controller('api/workflows')
export class WorkflowsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly commandBus: CommandBus,
    private readonly queryBus: QueryBus,
    private readonly workflowRepo: WorkflowRepository,
    private readonly workflowVersionRepo: WorkflowVersionRepository,
  ) {}

  @Get()
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
  @ApiBearerAuth()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of workflows owned by caller' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'List of workflows returned' })
  async getWorkflows(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
import { CommandHandler, ICommandHandler } from '@nestjs/cqrs';
import { NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { WorkflowDraft } from '../../domain/entities/workflow-draft.entity';
import { WorkflowRepository } from '../../domain/repositories/workflow.repository';
import { WorkflowDraftRepository } from '../../domain/repositories/workflow-draft.repository';

export class SaveDraftCommand {
  constructor(
    public readonly workflowId: string,
    public readonly definition: Record<string, any>,
  ) {}
}

@CommandHandler(SaveDraftCommand)
export class SaveDraftHandler implements ICommandHandler<SaveDraftCommand> {
  constructor(
    private readonly workflowRepo: WorkflowRepository,
    private readonly workflowDraftRepo: WorkflowDraftRepository,
  ) {}

  async execute(command: SaveDraftCommand): Promise<string> {
    const { workflowId, definition } = command;

    const existing = await this.workflowRepo.findById(workflowId);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Workflow with ID ${workflowId} not found.`);
    }

    const draft = WorkflowDraft.create(workflowId, definition);
    draft.validationErrors = null; // Clear previous validation errors
    await this.workflowDraftRepo.upsert(draft);

    return workflowId;
  }
}

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { triggerKeys } from '../hooks/useWorkflowTriggers';
import { useNodesState, useEdgesState, useReactFlow, ReactFlowProvider } from '@xyflow/react';
import type { Node, Edge } from '@xyflow/react';
import { workflowService } from '../services/workflow.service';
import { DesignerLayout } from '../components/DesignerLayout';
import { VersionHistoryDialog } from '../components/VersionHistoryDialog';
import { useDesignerStore } from '../store/designer.store';
import { PublishValidationDialog } from '../components/PublishValidationDialog';
import {
  WorkflowPublishValidationError,
  type WorkflowValidationIssue,
} from '../models/workflow-validation.model';
import { resolveOutputs, outputOfHandle } from '../utils/node-outputs';

interface DesignerPageProps {
  workflowId?: string;
  onBack?: () => void;
}

interface WorkflowDraft {
  definition?: {
    nodes?: Node[];
    edges?: Edge[];
  };
  validationErrors?: {
    message?: string;
    issues?: WorkflowValidationIssue[];
  } | null;
}

const VALIDATION_NODE_CLASS = 'workflow-validation-error';

function updateValidationHighlights(
  nodes: Node[],
  issues: WorkflowValidationIssue[],
): Node[] {
  const invalidNodeIds = new Set(
    issues.flatMap((issue) => (issue.nodeId ? [issue.nodeId] : [])),
  );
  let changed = false;

  const updatedNodes = nodes.map((node) => {
    const classNames = (node.className ?? '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    const hasValidationClass = classNames.includes(VALIDATION_NODE_CLASS);
    const shouldHighlight = invalidNodeIds.has(node.id);

    if (shouldHighlight && !hasValidationClass) {
      classNames.push(VALIDATION_NODE_CLASS);
      changed = true;
    } else if (!shouldHighlight && hasValidationClass) {
      changed = true;
      return {
        ...node,
        className: classNames
          .filter((className) => className !== VALIDATION_NODE_CLASS)
          .join(' '),
      };
    }

    if (shouldHighlight && !hasValidationClass) {
      return { ...node, className: classNames.join(' ') };
    }
    return node;
  });

  return changed ? updatedNodes : nodes;
}

function DesignerPageInner({ workflowId: propWorkflowId, onBack: propOnBack }: DesignerPageProps) {
  const { workflowId: paramWorkflowId } = useParams<{ workflowId: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const workflowId = propWorkflowId || paramWorkflowId || '';
  const onBack = propOnBack || (() => navigate('/workflows'));

  const { setCenter, getNode } = useReactFlow();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const [nodes, setNodes, onNodesChange] = useNodesState<Node>([]);
  const [edges, setEdges, onEdgesChange] = useEdgesState<Edge>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const isSaving = useDesignerStore((state) => state.isSaving);
  const setIsSaving = useDesignerStore((state) => state.setIsSaving);
  const setValidationIssues = useDesignerStore((state) => state.setValidationIssues);

  const saveTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const isFirstLoad = useRef(true);
  const [publishValidation, setPublishValidation] = useState<{
    message: string;
    issues: WorkflowValidationIssue[];
  } | null>(null);
  const [validationDialogOpen, setValidationDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isPublishing, setIsPublishing] = useState(false);
  const [historyOpen, setHistoryOpen] = useState(false);

  const setNodeTypes = useDesignerStore((state) => state.setNodeTypes);

  // Load draft on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    async function loadData() {
      try {
        const [draft, nodeTypes] = await Promise.all([
          workflowService.getDraft(workflowId) as Promise<WorkflowDraft>,
          workflowService.getNodeTypes(),
        ]);

        if (isMounted) {
          if (draft?.definition) {
            const rawNodes = (draft.definition.nodes || []) as Node[];
            const safeNodes = rawNodes.map((n, idx) => ({
              ...n,
              position: n.position || { x: 250, y: 100 + idx * 120 },
            }));
            setNodes(safeNodes);
            setEdges(draft.definition.edges || []);
          }
          if (draft?.validationErrors) {
            const issues = draft.validationErrors.issues ?? [];
            setPublishValidation({
              message:
                draft.validationErrors.message ?? 'Workflow validation failed.',
              issues,
            });
            setValidationIssues(issues);
            setNodes((currentNodes) =>
              updateValidationHighlights(currentNodes, issues),
            );
          }
          setNodeTypes(nodeTypes);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load workflow data', error);
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) setLoading(false);
      }
    }

    loadData();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [workflowId, setNodes, setEdges, setNodeTypes, setValidationIssues]);

  // Auto-save logic (debounced)
  const saveDraft = useCallback(async (currentNodes: Node[], currentEdges: Edge[]) => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const definition = {
        nodes: currentNodes,
        edges: currentEdges,
        viewport: { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 },
      };
      await workflowService.saveDraft(workflowId, definition);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to save draft', error);
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  }, [workflowId, setIsSaving]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (loading) return;
    if (isFirstLoad.current) {
      isFirstLoad.current = false;
      return;
    }

    if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);
    }

    saveTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      saveDraft(nodes, edges);
    }, 2000);

    return () => {
      if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [nodes, edges, loading, saveDraft]);

  const handleNodeDataChange = useCallback((nodeId: string, data: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    setNodes((nds) =>
      nds.map((n) => {
        if (n.id === nodeId) {
          return { ...n, data };
        }
        return n;
      })
    );
    // A deleted Switch rule takes its connections with it.
    const schema = useDesignerStore.getState().nodeTypes.find((t) => t.key === data.key)?.configSchema;
    const kept = new Set(resolveOutputs(schema, data.config).map((output) => output.key));
    setEdges((eds) => {
      const next = eds.filter((edge) => {
        const output = edge.source === nodeId ? outputOfHandle(edge.sourceHandle) : null;
        return output === null || kept.has(output);
      });
      return next.length === eds.length ? eds : next;
    });
  }, [setNodes, setEdges]);

  const handlePublish = async () => {
    setIsPublishing(true);
    setPublishValidation(null);
    setValidationDialogOpen(false);

    // Ensure latest changes are saved first
    if (saveTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);
    await saveDraft(nodes, edges);

    try {
      const published = await workflowService.publishWorkflow(workflowId);
      setPublishValidation(null);
      setValidationDialogOpen(false);
      useDesignerStore.getState().setValidationIssues([]);
      setNodes((currentNodes) => updateValidationHighlights(currentNodes, []));
      void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: triggerKeys.activation(workflowId) });
      const activation = published.activation;
      if (activation && (activation.error || !activation.active)) {
        // The new version could not listen.
        const reason = activation.error ?? 'its triggers could not listen';
        setPublishValidation({
          message: activation.active
            ? `Published version ${published.versionNumber}, but it could not start listening: ${reason}. The previous version keeps answering events. Fix it and publish again.`
            : `Published version ${published.versionNumber}, but the workflow was turned off: ${reason}. Fix it, publish, then activate again.`,
          issues: [],
        });
        setValidationDialogOpen(true);
        return;
      }
      const followUp = published.activation?.active
        ? `Workflow published! Version ${published.versionNumber} is now listening.`
        : 'Workflow published successfully!';
      if (
        window.confirm(
          `${followUp} Would you like to view the version history and run it?`,
        )
      ) {
        navigate(`/workflows/${workflowId}/versions`);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (err instanceof WorkflowPublishValidationError) {
        setPublishValidation({ message: err.message, issues: err.issues });
        setValidationDialogOpen(true);
        useDesignerStore.getState().setValidationIssues(err.issues);
        setNodes((currentNodes) =>
          updateValidationHighlights(currentNodes, err.issues),
        );
      } else if (err instanceof Error) {
        setPublishValidation({ message: err.message, issues: [] });
        setValidationDialogOpen(true);
      } else {
        setPublishValidation({ message: String(err), issues: [] });
        setValidationDialogOpen(true);
      }
    } finally {
      setIsPublishing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleFocusNode = useCallback(
    (nodeId: string) => {
      setValidationDialogOpen(false);
      useDesignerStore.getState().setSelectedNodeId(nodeId);

      const targetNode = getNode(nodeId) || nodes.find((n) => n.id === nodeId);
      if (targetNode?.position) {
        setCenter(targetNode.position.x + 96, targetNode.position.y + 38, {
          zoom: 1.25,
          duration: 600,
        });
      }
    },
    [getNode, nodes, setCenter],
  );

  const handleRestoreSuccess = useCallback(
    (definition: { nodes?: Node[]; edges?: Edge[] } | unknown) => {
      const def = definition as { nodes?: Node[]; edges?: Edge[] };
      if (def?.nodes) {
        const safeNodes = def.nodes.map((n, idx) => ({
          ...n,
          position: n.position || { x: 250, y: 100 + idx * 120 },
        }));
        setNodes(safeNodes);
      }
      if (def?.edges) setEdges(def.edges);
      setPublishValidation(null);
      setValidationDialogOpen(false);
      useDesignerStore.getState().setValidationIssues([]);
      setNodes((currentNodes) => updateValidationHighlights(currentNodes, []));
    },
    [setNodes, setEdges],
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-screen w-screen items-center justify-center bg-gray-50">
        <div className="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-600 animate-pulse">Loading designer...</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <PublishValidationDialog
        open={validationDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setValidationDialogOpen}
        message={publishValidation?.message}
        issues={publishValidation?.issues ?? []}
        nodes={nodes}
        onSelectNode={handleFocusNode}
      />
      <DesignerLayout
        workflowId={workflowId}
        nodes={nodes}
        edges={edges}
        onNodesChange={onNodesChange}
        onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange}
        setNodes={setNodes}
        setEdges={setEdges}
        onNodeDataChange={handleNodeDataChange}
        onBack={onBack}
        isSaving={isSaving}
        onPublish={handlePublish}
        isPublishing={isPublishing}
        onOpenHistory={() => setHistoryOpen(true)}
        onViewVersions={() => navigate(`/workflows/${workflowId}/versions`)}
        validationIssuesCount={
          publishValidation
            ? Math.max(publishValidation.issues.length, publishValidation.message ? 1 : 0)
            : 0
        }
        onOpenValidation={() => setValidationDialogOpen(true)}
      />
      <VersionHistoryDialog
        workflowId={workflowId}
        open={historyOpen}
        onOpenChange={setHistoryOpen}
        onRestoreSuccess={handleRestoreSuccess}
      />
    </>
  );
}

export function DesignerPage(props: DesignerPageProps) {
  return (
    <ReactFlowProvider>
      <DesignerPageInner {...props} />
    </ReactFlowProvider>
  );
}
import { Sidebar } from './Sidebar';
import { PropertiesPanel } from './PropertiesPanel';
import { ActiveToggle } from './ActiveToggle';
import { Canvas } from './Canvas';
import { useDesignerStore } from '../store/designer.store';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { History, ArrowLeft, GitBranch, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import type { Node, Edge, OnNodesChange, OnEdgesChange } from '@xyflow/react';

interface DesignerLayoutProps {
  workflowId: string;
  nodes: Node[];
  edges: Edge[];
  onNodesChange: OnNodesChange;
  onEdgesChange: OnEdgesChange;
  setNodes: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Node[]>>;
  setEdges: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Edge[]>>;
  onNodeDataChange: (nodeId: string, data: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
  onBack: () => void;
  isSaving: boolean;
  onPublish: () => void;
  isPublishing: boolean;
  onOpenHistory?: () => void;
  onViewVersions?: () => void;
  validationIssuesCount?: number;
  onOpenValidation?: () => void;
}

export function DesignerLayout({
  workflowId,
  nodes,
  edges,
  onNodesChange,
  onEdgesChange,
  setNodes,
  setEdges,
  onNodeDataChange,
  onBack,
  isSaving,
  onPublish,
  isPublishing,
  onOpenHistory,
  onViewVersions,
  validationIssuesCount,
  onOpenValidation,
}: DesignerLayoutProps) {
  const setSelectedNodeId = useDesignerStore((state) => state.setSelectedNodeId);

  // Removes the node together with the edges attached to it.
  const handleDeleteNode = (nodeId: string) => {
    setNodes((nds) => nds.filter((node) => node.id !== nodeId));
    setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((edge) => edge.source !== nodeId && edge.target !== nodeId));
    setSelectedNodeId(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen overflow-hidden bg-gray-50">
      <header className="h-14 border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm z-20">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Button 
            variant="ghost" 
            size="sm"
            onClick={onBack}
            className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground gap-1.5"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="size-4" />
            Back
          </Button>
          <div className="h-4 w-px bg-border" />
          <h1 className="font-semibold text-foreground text-base">Workflow Designer</h1>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {Boolean(validationIssuesCount) && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onOpenValidation}
              className="gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600 border-rose-300 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:border-rose-900/50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 animate-in fade-in"
            >
              <AlertCircle className="size-3.5 text-rose-500" />
              <span>Error</span>
              <span className="rounded-full bg-rose-200/80 px-1.5 py-0.2 text-[10px] text-rose-700">
                {validationIssuesCount}
              </span>
            </Button>
          )}

          <ActiveToggle workflowId={workflowId} />
          <div className="h-4 w-px bg-border" />
          {isSaving ? (
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground italic">Saving...</span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-xs text-emerald-600 font-medium">Draft saved</span>
          )}
          {onOpenHistory && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onOpenHistory}
              className="gap-1.5 text-xs"
            >
              <History className="size-3.5" />
              Version History
            </Button>
          )}
          {onViewVersions && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onViewVersions}
              className="gap-1.5 text-xs text-primary border-primary/20 hover:bg-primary/5"
            >
              <GitBranch className="size-3.5" />
              Versions (Run UI)
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button
            variant="default"
            size="sm"
            onClick={onPublish}
            disabled={isPublishing || isSaving}
            className="gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium"
          >
            {isPublishing ? 'Publishing...' : 'Publish'}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </header>
      
      <main className="flex-1 flex overflow-hidden relative">
        <Sidebar />
        <Canvas 
          nodes={nodes} 
          edges={edges} 
          onNodesChange={onNodesChange} 
          onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange} 
          setNodes={setNodes} 
          setEdges={setEdges} 
        />
        <PropertiesPanel
          workflowId={workflowId}
          nodes={nodes}
          onNodeDataChange={onNodeDataChange}
          onDeleteNode={handleDeleteNode}
        />
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Sidebar } from './Sidebar';
import { PropertiesPanel } from './PropertiesPanel';
import { ActiveToggle } from './ActiveToggle';
import { Canvas } from './Canvas';
import { useDesignerStore } from '../store/designer.store';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { History, ArrowLeft, GitBranch, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import type { Node, Edge, OnNodesChange, OnEdgesChange } from '@xyflow/react';

interface DesignerLayoutProps {
  workflowId: string;
  nodes: Node[];
  edges: Edge[];
  onNodesChange: OnNodesChange;
  onEdgesChange: OnEdgesChange;
  setNodes: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Node[]>>;
  setEdges: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Edge[]>>;
  onNodeDataChange: (nodeId: string, data: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
  onBack: () => void;
  isSaving: boolean;
  onPublish: () => void;
  isPublishing: boolean;
  onOpenHistory?: () => void;
  onViewVersions?: () => void;
  validationIssuesCount?: number;
  onOpenValidation?: () => void;
}

export function DesignerLayout({
  workflowId,
  nodes,
  edges,
  onNodesChange,
  onEdgesChange,
  setNodes,
  setEdges,
  onNodeDataChange,
  onBack,
  isSaving,
  onPublish,
  isPublishing,
  onOpenHistory,
  onViewVersions,
  validationIssuesCount,
  onOpenValidation,
}: DesignerLayoutProps) {
  const setSelectedNodeId = useDesignerStore((state) => state.setSelectedNodeId);

  // Removes the node together with the edges attached to it.
  const handleDeleteNode = (nodeId: string) => {
    setNodes((nds) => nds.filter((node) => node.id !== nodeId));
    setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((edge) => edge.source !== nodeId && edge.target !== nodeId));
    setSelectedNodeId(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen overflow-hidden bg-gray-50">
      <header className="h-14 border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm z-20">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Button 
            variant="ghost" 
            size="sm"
            onClick={onBack}
            className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground gap-1.5"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="size-4" />
            Back
          </Button>
          <div className="h-4 w-px bg-border" />
          <h1 className="font-semibold text-foreground text-base">Workflow Designer</h1>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {Boolean(validationIssuesCount) && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onOpenValidation}
              className="gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600 border-rose-300 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:border-rose-900/50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 animate-in fade-in"
            >
              <AlertCircle className="size-3.5 text-rose-500" />
              <span>Error</span>
              <span className="rounded-full bg-rose-200/80 px-1.5 py-0.2 text-[10px] text-rose-700">
                {validationIssuesCount}
              </span>
            </Button>
          )}

          <ActiveToggle workflowId={workflowId} />
          <div className="h-4 w-px bg-border" />
          {isSaving ? (
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground italic">Saving...</span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-xs text-emerald-600 font-medium">Draft saved</span>
          )}
          {onOpenHistory && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onOpenHistory}
              className="gap-1.5 text-xs"
            >
              <History className="size-3.5" />
              Version History
            </Button>
          )}
          {onViewVersions && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onViewVersions}
              className="gap-1.5 text-xs text-primary border-primary/20 hover:bg-primary/5"
            >
              <GitBranch className="size-3.5" />
              Versions (Run UI)
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button
            variant="default"
            size="sm"
            onClick={onPublish}
            disabled={isPublishing || isSaving}
            className="gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium"
          >
            {isPublishing ? 'Publishing...' : 'Publish'}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </header>
      
      <main className="flex-1 flex overflow-hidden relative">
        <Sidebar />
        <Canvas 
          nodes={nodes} 
          edges={edges} 
          onNodesChange={onNodesChange} 
          onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange} 
          setNodes={setNodes} 
          setEdges={setEdges} 
        />
        <PropertiesPanel
          workflowId={workflowId}
          nodes={nodes}
          onNodeDataChange={onNodeDataChange}
          onDeleteNode={handleDeleteNode}
        />
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

* **Mã Catalog:** `memory.chat` | **Phân nhóm:** `DATA_PROCESSING`
* **Màu sắc / Icon:** Xanh ngọc `#14B8A6` | Icon `brain`
* **Cổng ra:** 1 cổng mặc định

#### 1. Dùng để làm gì?
Lưu trữ và nạp lịch sử chat giữa khách hàng và Chatbot AI trên Redis. Giúp AI có "trí nhớ", không bị quên ngữ cảnh các câu nói trước của khách.

#### 2. Ba chế độ sử dụng (Action Mode)
1. **`Load the conversation` (Nạp lịch sử):** Đặt ở **TRƯỚC** node AI LLM.
2. **`Save a turn` (Lưu câu hỏi & trả lời):** Đặt ở **SAU** khi bot đã có câu trả lời.
3. **`Forget the conversation` (Xóa bộ nhớ):** Dùng khi khách bấm nút "Kết thúc chat".

#### 3. Hướng dẫn cấu hình từng trường
| Tên trường trên UI | Bắt buộc | Điền gì vào đây? | Ví dụ cụ thể |
|---|:---:|---|---|
| **Action (mode)** | Có | Chọn `Load the conversation` hoặc `Save a turn`. | `Load the conversation` |
| **Session key** | Có | Khóa định danh phiên chat của khách hàng. | `{{$node["Messenger Trigger"].json.sender_id}}` |
| **Turns to load** | Ở mode load | Số lượt chat tối đa cần nạp cho AI đọc (mặc định: 10). | `10` |
| **Customer message** | Ở mode save | Câu hỏi của khách hàng lấy từ Trigger. | `{{$node["Messenger Trigger"].json.text}}` |
| **Bot reply** | Ở mode save | Câu trả lời của AI lấy từ node LLM. | `{{$node["LLM"].json.text}}` |
| **Forget after (days)** | Ở mode save | Số ngày tự động hủy bộ nhớ trên Redis nếu khách không nhắn tiếp (mặc định: 7 ngày). | `7` |

#### 4. Output Preview Schema (Ở mode Load)
```json
{
  "json": {
    "history": [
      { "role": "user", "content": "Shop có bán bàn phím cơ không?" },
      { "role": "assistant", "content": "Dạ bên mình có nhiều mẫu bàn phím cơ chính hãng ạ!" }
    ],
    "history_text": "User: Shop có bán bàn phím cơ không?\nAssistant: Dạ bên mình có nhiều mẫu..."
  }
}
```

#### 5. Danh sách Biểu thức copy dùng cho node sau:
- **`{{$json.history}}`** (Dán vào ô *Conversation history* của node AI LLM)

---

* **Mã Catalog:** `ai.llm.generate` | **Phân nhóm:** `AI`
* **Màu sắc / Icon:** Xanh dương `#0EA5E9` | Icon `sparkles`
* **Cổng ra:** 1 cổng mặc định

#### 1. Dùng để làm gì?
Gửi yêu cầu tới các mô hình AI thông minh hàng đầu thế giới (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 2.0 Flash) để tạo câu trả lời tự động, tóm tắt dữ liệu, phân loại ý định hoặc bóc tách thông tin dạng JSON.

#### 2. Điều kiện cần trước khi dùng
Có API Key của nhà cung cấp AI tương ứng và đã kết nối Credential trong FlowPilot:
- OpenAI: `sk-...`
- Google Gemini: `AIza...`

import {
  IntegrationPackage,
  TriggerNode,
  WebhookRequest,
} from '../core/package';
import { header } from '../core/text';

// Credentials of the caller must not end up in execution logs.
const HIDDEN_HEADERS = new Set([
  'authorization',
  'proxy-authorization',
  'cookie',
  'x-api-key',
]);

// Any system that can send an HTTP POST. Each node has its own secret URL,
// which is the only credential.
export const webhookTrigger: TriggerNode = {
  kind: 'trigger',
  key: 'webhook.trigger',
  displayName: 'Webhook',
  description: 'Start when an HTTP POST arrives at this node’s URL',
  icon: 'webhook',
  color: '#6366F1',
  properties: [],
  webhook: {
    scope: 'node',
    handle({ request }) {
      if (request.method !== 'POST') {
        return {
          status: 405,
          body: { success: false, message: 'Send a POST request' },
          events: [],
        };
      }
      const idempotencyKey = header(request.headers, 'idempotency-key')?.trim();
      return {
        status: 202,
        events: [
          {
            ...(idempotencyKey ? { id: idempotencyKey } : {}),
            json: webhookJson(request, new Date()),
          },
        ],
      };
    },
  },
};

export function webhookJson(
  request: WebhookRequest,
  receivedAt: Date,
): Record<string, unknown> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(request.headers)) {
    if (value === undefined || HIDDEN_HEADERS.has(name.toLowerCase())) continue;
    headers[name.toLowerCase()] = Array.isArray(value)
      ? value.join(', ')
      : value;
  }
  return {
    body: request.body ?? null,
    query: request.query,
    headers,
    received_at: receivedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

export const webhookPackage: IntegrationPackage = {
  key: 'webhook',
  displayName: 'Webhook',
  credentials: [],
  nodes: [webhookTrigger],
};

  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);

  const [templatesOpen, setTemplatesOpen] = useState(false);
  const [creatingTemplate, setCreatingTemplate] = useState(false);

  const handleCreateFromTemplate = async (template: WorkflowTemplate) => {
    try {
      setCreatingTemplate(true);
      const workflowId = await workflowService.createWorkflow(template.title);
      await workflowService.saveDraft(workflowId, {
        nodes: structuredClone(template.nodes),
        edges: structuredClone(template.edges),
        viewport: { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 },
      });
      navigate(`/workflows/${workflowId}`);
    } catch {
      setActionError('Could not create a workflow from this template. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setCreatingTemplate(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRename = async () => {
    if (!editingId || !editingName.trim()) return;
    try {
      setSavingName(true);
      await workflowService.renameWorkflow(editingId, editingName.trim());
      setEditingId(null);
      await refetch();
    } catch {
      setActionError('Could not rename the workflow. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setSavingName(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!deletingWorkflow) return;
    try {
      setDeleting(true);
      await workflowService.deleteWorkflow(deletingWorkflow.id);
      setDeletingWorkflow(null);
      await refetch();
    } catch {
      setActionError('Could not delete the workflow. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateNew = async () => {
    try {
      setCreating(true);
      const newId = await workflowService.createWorkflow();
      navigate(`/workflows/${newId}`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to create workflow', err);
      alert('Không thể tạo quy trình mới. Vui lòng thử lại!');
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

import { Sidebar } from './Sidebar';
import { PropertiesPanel } from './PropertiesPanel';
import { ActiveToggle } from './ActiveToggle';
import { Canvas } from './Canvas';

import type { Node, Edge, OnNodesChange, OnEdgesChange } from '@xyflow/react';

interface DesignerLayoutProps {
  workflowId: string;
  nodes: Node[];
  edges: Edge[];
  onNodesChange: OnNodesChange;
  onEdgesChange: OnEdgesChange;
  setNodes: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Node[]>>;
  setEdges: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Edge[]>>;
  onNodeDataChange: (nodeId: string, data: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
  onBack: () => void;
  isSaving: boolean;
  onPublish: () => void;
  isPublishing: boolean;
  onOpenHistory?: () => void;
  onViewVersions?: () => void;
  validationIssuesCount?: number;
  onOpenValidation?: () => void;
  onUseTemplate: (template: WorkflowTemplate) => Promise<boolean>;
}

export function DesignerLayout({
  workflowId,
  nodes,
  edges,
  onNodesChange,
  onEdgesChange,
  setNodes,
  setEdges,
  onNodeDataChange,
  onBack,
  isSaving,
  onPublish,
  isPublishing,
  onOpenHistory,
  onViewVersions,
  validationIssuesCount,
  onOpenValidation,
  onUseTemplate,
}: DesignerLayoutProps) {
  const setSelectedNodeId = useDesignerStore((state) => state.setSelectedNodeId);
  const [templatesOpen, setTemplatesOpen] = useState(false);
  const [usingTemplate, setUsingTemplate] = useState(false);

  const handleUseTemplate = async (template: WorkflowTemplate) => {
    setUsingTemplate(true);
    try {
      if (await onUseTemplate(template)) setTemplatesOpen(false);
    } finally {
      setUsingTemplate(false);
    }
  };

  // Removes the node together with the edges attached to it.
  const handleDeleteNode = (nodeId: string) => {
    setNodes((nds) => nds.filter((node) => node.id !== nodeId));
    setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((edge) => edge.source !== nodeId && edge.target !== nodeId));
    setSelectedNodeId(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen overflow-hidden bg-gray-50">
      <header className="h-14 border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm z-20">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Button 
            variant="ghost" 
            size="sm"
            onClick={onBack}
            className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground gap-1.5"
          >
    (nodeId: string) => {
      setValidationDialogOpen(false);
      useDesignerStore.getState().setSelectedNodeId(nodeId);

      const targetNode = getNode(nodeId) || nodes.find((n) => n.id === nodeId);
      if (targetNode?.position) {
        setCenter(targetNode.position.x + 96, targetNode.position.y + 38, {
          zoom: 1.25,
          duration: 600,
        });
      }
    },
    [getNode, nodes, setCenter],
  );

  const handleRestoreSuccess = useCallback(
    (definition: { nodes?: Node[]; edges?: Edge[] } | unknown) => {
      const def = definition as { nodes?: Node[]; edges?: Edge[] };
      if (def?.nodes) {
        const safeNodes = def.nodes.map((n, idx) => ({
          ...n,
          position: n.position || { x: 250, y: 100 + idx * 120 },
        }));
        setNodes(safeNodes);
      }
      if (def?.edges) setEdges(def.edges);
      setPublishValidation(null);
      setValidationDialogOpen(false);
      useDesignerStore.getState().setValidationIssues([]);
      setNodes((currentNodes) => updateValidationHighlights(currentNodes, []));
    },
    [setNodes, setEdges],
  );

  const handleUseTemplate = useCallback(async (template: WorkflowTemplate) => {
    if (nodes.length > 0 && !window.confirm('Replace the current draft with this template?')) return false;
    const nextNodes = structuredClone(template.nodes);
    const nextEdges = structuredClone(template.edges);
    setNodes(nextNodes);
    setEdges(nextEdges);
    useDesignerStore.getState().setSelectedNodeId(null);
    await saveDraft(nextNodes, nextEdges);
    return true;
  }, [nodes.length, saveDraft, setNodes, setEdges]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-screen w-screen items-center justify-center bg-gray-50">
        <div className="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-600 animate-pulse">Loading designer...</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <PublishValidationDialog
        open={validationDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setValidationDialogOpen}
        message={publishValidation?.message}
        issues={publishValidation?.issues ?? []}
        nodes={nodes}
        onSelectNode={handleFocusNode}
      />
      <DesignerLayout
        workflowId={workflowId}
        nodes={nodes}
        edges={edges}
        onNodesChange={onNodesChange}
        onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange}
        setNodes={setNodes}
        setEdges={setEdges}
        onNodeDataChange={handleNodeDataChange}
        onBack={onBack}
        isSaving={isSaving}
        onPublish={handlePublish}
        isPublishing={isPublishing}
        onOpenHistory={() => setHistoryOpen(true)}
        onViewVersions={() => navigate(`/workflows/${workflowId}/versions`)}
        validationIssuesCount={
          publishValidation
            ? Math.max(publishValidation.issues.length, publishValidation.message ? 1 : 0)
            : 0
        }
        onOpenValidation={() => setValidationDialogOpen(true)}
        onUseTemplate={handleUseTemplate}
      />
      <VersionHistoryDialog
        workflowId={workflowId}
        open={historyOpen}
        onOpenChange={setHistoryOpen}

// Outputs of a node, read from the `x-outputs` of its config schema (same
// rules as the backend, libs/shared/src/utils/node-outputs.ts):
//   { static: [{ key, label }] }                          fixed outputs (IF)
//   { fromConfig: 'rules', labelField, fallback: true }   one per entry of a config list (Switch)
// A node without `x-outputs` has the single main output.
export interface OutputDef {
  key: string;
  label: string;
}

export const MAIN_OUTPUT = 'main';
const OUTPUT_HANDLE_PREFIX = 'out:';

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

export function resolveOutputs(schema: unknown, config: unknown): OutputDef[] {
  const spec = isRecord(schema) ? schema['x-outputs'] : undefined;
  const main = [{ key: MAIN_OUTPUT, label: 'Output' }];
  if (!isRecord(spec)) return main;

  if (Array.isArray(spec.static)) {
    return spec.static.filter(
      (entry): entry is OutputDef =>
        isRecord(entry) && typeof entry.key === 'string' && typeof entry.label === 'string',
    );
  }
  if (typeof spec.fromConfig === 'string') {
    const list = isRecord(config) ? config[spec.fromConfig] : undefined;
    const entries: unknown[] = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
    const labelField = typeof spec.labelField === 'string' ? spec.labelField : 'label';
    const outputs = entries.map((entry, index): OutputDef => {
      const label = isRecord(entry) ? entry[labelField] : undefined;
      const id = isRecord(entry) ? entry.id : undefined;
      return {
        key: typeof id === 'string' && id ? `rule_${id}` : `rule_${index}`,
        label: typeof label === 'string' && label.trim() ? label : `Rule ${index + 1}`,
      };
    });
    if (spec.fallback === true) outputs.push({ key: 'fallback', label: 'Fallback' });
    return outputs;
  }
  return main;
}

// A node with named outputs draws one labelled handle per output; the others keep the four plain sides.
export function hasNamedOutputs(outputs: OutputDef[]): boolean {
  return outputs.length !== 1 || outputs[0].key !== MAIN_OUTPUT;
}

export function outputHandleId(key: string): string {
  return `${OUTPUT_HANDLE_PREFIX}${key}`;
}

export function outputOfHandle(handle: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  return typeof handle === 'string' && handle.startsWith(OUTPUT_HANDLE_PREFIX)
    ? handle.slice(OUTPUT_HANDLE_PREFIX.length)
    : null;
}

import { Injectable, Logger, OnApplicationBootstrap } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConnectorAuthType, NodeCategory } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '@app/database';
import {
  credentialConfigSchema,
  nodeConfigSchema,
  PackageRegistry,
} from '@app/apps';

// Integration packages are the source of truth for their node and credential
// types: they are written into the catalog every time the server starts, so a
// new package needs no seed change.
@Injectable()
export class PackageCatalogSync implements OnApplicationBootstrap {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(PackageCatalogSync.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly registry: PackageRegistry,
  ) {}

  async onApplicationBootstrap(): Promise<void> {
    await this.sync();
  }

  async sync(): Promise<void> {
    const connectorIds = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const credential of this.registry.allCredentialTypes()) {
      const data = {
        name: credential.displayName,
        authType: credential.oauth2
          ? ConnectorAuthType.OAUTH2
          : ConnectorAuthType.API_KEY,
        configSchema: credentialConfigSchema(credential) as object,
        isActive: true,
      };
      const row = await this.prisma.connector.upsert({
        where: { key: credential.key },
        update: data,
        create: { key: credential.key, ...data },
      });
      connectorIds.set(credential.key, row.id);
    }

    const nodes = this.registry.allNodes();
    for (const node of nodes) {
      const data = {
        displayName: node.displayName,
        icon: node.icon,
        color: node.color,
        category:
          node.kind === 'trigger'
            ? NodeCategory.TRIGGER
            : NodeCategory.INTEGRATION,
        description: node.description,
        configSchema: nodeConfigSchema(node) as object,
        inputSchema: { type: 'object' },
        outputSchema: { type: 'object' },
        connectorId: node.credentialType
          ? (connectorIds.get(node.credentialType) ?? null)
          : null,
        isActive: true,
      };
      await this.prisma.nodeTypeDefinition.upsert({
        where: { key: node.key },
        update: data,
        create: { key: node.key, ...data },
      });
    }
    this.logger.log(
      `Synced ${nodes.length} node types and ${connectorIds.size} credential types from ${this.registry.packages.length} packages`,
    );
  }
}

export interface TriggerNode extends NodeBase {
  kind: 'trigger';
  webhook: WebhookSpec;
}

export interface ActionNode extends NodeBase {
  kind: 'action';
  // Runs once per input item with the item's resolved parameters.
  execute(context: {
    parameters: Record<string, unknown>;
    credential: Record<string, unknown> | null;
    item: { json: ItemJson };
  }): Promise<ItemJson | ItemJson[] | null>;
}

export type PackageNode = TriggerNode | ActionNode;

export interface IntegrationPackage {
  key: string;
  displayName: string;
  credentials: CredentialType[];
  nodes: PackageNode[];
}

  }

      description: 'Combine all items into a single item',
      configSchema: AGGREGATE_CONFIG_SCHEMA,
    },
    {
      id: '44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444446',
      key: 'ai.llm.generate',
      displayName: 'LLM',
      icon: 'sparkles',
      color: '#0EA5E9',
      category: NodeCategory.AI,
      description: 'Send a prompt to a language model and get its answer',
      configSchema: LLM_GENERATE_CONFIG_SCHEMA,
    },
  ];
  for (const { id, ...nodeType } of nodeTypes) {
    const data = {
      ...nodeType,
      inputSchema: { type: 'object' },
      outputSchema: { type: 'object' },
      // Not tied to one connector: the provider is chosen on the node.
      connectorId: null,
      isActive: true,
    };
    await prisma.nodeTypeDefinition.upsert({
      where: { key: nodeType.key },
      update: data,
      create: { id, ...data },
    });
  }

  // 3. Existing node types: only their config schema changed (expressions,
  // field order, Gmail `to`), so nothing else on them is touched.
  console.log('Updating config schemas of the MVP node types...');
  const updatedSchemas = [
    ['trigger.manual', MANUAL_TRIGGER_CONFIG_SCHEMA],
    ['integration.google_sheet.readRows', GOOGLE_SHEET_READ_ROWS_CONFIG_SCHEMA],
    ['logic.filter', FILTER_CONFIG_SCHEMA],
    ['integration.gmail.send', GMAIL_SEND_CONFIG_SCHEMA],
  ] as const;
  for (const [key, configSchema] of updatedSchemas) {
    await prisma.nodeTypeDefinition.update({
      where: { key },
      data: { configSchema },
    });
  }

  console.log('Seeded AI catalogs successfully!');
}

import type { Edge, Node } from '@xyflow/react';

export interface WorkflowTemplate {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  tags: string[];
  nodes: Node[];
  edges: Edge[];
}

function node(id: string, key: string, name: string, x: number, y: number, config: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Node {
  const type = key.startsWith('messenger.trigger') || key.startsWith('webhook.') || key === 'trigger.manual' ? 'triggerNode' : 'actionNode';
  return { id, type, position: { x, y }, data: { key, name, config } };
}

function edge(source: string, target: string, id: string, sourceHandle = 'right-source', targetHandle = 'left-target'): Edge {
  return { id, source, target, sourceHandle, targetHandle, type: 'smoothstep' };
}

import { ArrowRight, Workflow } from 'lucide-react';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { WORKFLOW_TEMPLATES, type WorkflowTemplate } from '../templates/catalog';

interface TemplateGalleryDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  onSelect: (template: WorkflowTemplate) => void;
  busy?: boolean;
}

export function TemplateGalleryDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  onSelect,
  busy = false,
}: TemplateGalleryDialogProps) {
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="flex w-[min(94vw,1120px)] max-h-[min(88vh,850px)] sm:max-w-6xl flex-col gap-0 overflow-hidden p-0">
        <DialogHeader className="border-b bg-muted/30 px-6 py-5 pr-12">
          <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
              <Workflow className="size-4" />
            </span>
            <Badge variant="secondary">{WORKFLOW_TEMPLATES.length} starter workflows</Badge>
          </div>
          <DialogTitle className="text-xl">Start with a template</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription className="max-w-2xl text-sm">
            Choose a workflow, then connect your accounts and adjust its settings before publishing.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="grid min-h-0 gap-4 overflow-y-auto p-5 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:p-6">
          {WORKFLOW_TEMPLATES.map((template, index) => (
            <TemplateCard
              key={template.id}
              template={template}
              index={index}
              busy={busy}
              onSelect={onSelect}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

interface TemplateCardProps {
  template: WorkflowTemplate;
  index: number;
  busy: boolean;
  onSelect: (template: WorkflowTemplate) => void;
}

function TemplateCard({ template, index, busy, onSelect }: TemplateCardProps) {
  return (
    <Card className="group flex h-full min-w-0 flex-col overflow-hidden border-border/80 p-0 transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-primary/40 hover:shadow-md">
      <CardContent className="flex flex-1 flex-col p-0">
        <div className="flex min-h-36 flex-col justify-between bg-gradient-to-br from-muted/80 via-muted/40 to-background p-4">
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <span className="flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border bg-background/80 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground shadow-xs">
              {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
            </span>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-1.5">
              {template.tags.map((tag) => (
                <Badge key={tag} variant="outline" className="bg-background/70 text-[10px] font-medium">
                  {tag}
                </Badge>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 pt-5" aria-label="Workflow steps">
            {template.nodes.map((node, nodeIndex) => (
              <div key={node.id} className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="max-w-40 truncate rounded-md border bg-background/90 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-foreground shadow-xs">
                  {String(node.data.name)}
                </span>
                {nodeIndex < template.nodes.length - 1 && (
                  <ArrowRight className="size-3 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground/70" aria-hidden="true" />
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col p-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold tracking-tight">{template.title}</h3>
          <p className="mt-1.5 min-h-10 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            {template.description}
          </p>
          <div className="mt-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-4">
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {template.nodes.length} nodes · {template.edges.length} connections
            </span>
            <Button disabled={busy} onClick={() => onSelect(template)} size="sm" className="gap-2">
              {busy ? 'Adding…' : 'Use template'}
              {!busy && <ArrowRight className="size-3.5" />}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
