import { Controller, Get, Query, Req, Res, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { QueryBus, CommandBus } from '@nestjs/cqrs';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '@app/auth/infrastructure/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import { GetGoogleAuthUrlQuery } from './application/queries/get-google-auth-url.query';
import { HandleGoogleCallbackCommand } from './application/commands/handle-google-callback.command';

@Controller('api/integrations/google')
export class GoogleOauthController {
  constructor(
    private readonly queryBus: QueryBus,
    private readonly commandBus: CommandBus,
  ) {}

  @Get('auth')
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
  async auth(@Req() req: Request & { user?: { id?: string } }) {
    const userId = req.user?.id || 'unknown';

    const url = String(
      await this.queryBus.execute(new GetGoogleAuthUrlQuery(userId)),
    );

    return { url };
  }

  @Get('callback')
  async callback(
    @Query('code') code: string,
    @Query('state') state: string,
    @Res() res: Response,
  ) {
    if (!code || !state) {
      return res.status(400).send('Code or state is missing');
    }

    const credentialId = String(
      await this.commandBus.execute(
        new HandleGoogleCallbackCommand(code, state),
      ),
    );

    res.send(`
      <script>
        window.opener.postMessage({ type: 'oauth-success', credentialId: '${credentialId}' }, '*');
        window.close();
      </script>
    `);
  }
}
import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Get,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  ParseUUIDPipe,
  Post,
  Query,
  Res,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiOperation, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import type { Response } from 'express';
import { IsNotEmpty, IsString, MaxLength } from 'class-validator';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '@app/auth/infrastructure/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import {
  AuthenticatedUser,
  CurrentUser,
} from '@app/auth/infrastructure/decorators/current-user.decorator';
import {
  frontendOrigin,
  publicBaseUrl,
} from '@app/shared/utils/public-base-url';
import { OAuth2Service } from './application/oauth2.service';

class CompleteOAuth2Dto {
  @IsString()
  @IsNotEmpty()
  @MaxLength(200)
  state!: string;

  @IsString()
  @IsNotEmpty()
  @MaxLength(4096)
  code!: string;
}

@ApiTags('integrations')
@Controller('api/oauth2')
export class OAuth2Controller {
  constructor(private readonly oauth2: OAuth2Service) {}

  @Get('auth')
  @ApiBearerAuth()
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Authorization URL of an OAuth2 credential' })
  async auth(
    @Query('credentialId', ParseUUIDPipe) credentialId: string,
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
  ) {
    const { url, state } = await this.oauth2.authorizationUrl(
      credentialId,
      user.id,
    );
    // The designer accepts the callback's message only from this origin and
    // with this state.
    return { url, state, callbackOrigin: new URL(publicBaseUrl()).origin };
  }

  // The provider redirects the pop-up here. Nothing is stored: the page hands
  // the code to the designer window (and only to it), which completes the
  // sign-in with its own login, then closes.
  @Get('callback')
  callback(
    @Res() res: Response,
    @Query('code') code?: string,
    @Query('state') state?: string,
    @Query('error_description') denied?: string,
  ) {
    if (!code || !state) {
      res.status(400).send(
        popupPage({
          type: 'oauth2-callback',
          status: 'error',
          state: state ?? null,
          message: denied || 'Sign-in was cancelled',
        }),
      );
      return;
    }
    res.send(
      popupPage({ type: 'oauth2-callback', status: 'success', state, code }),
    );
  }

  @Post('complete')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiBearerAuth()
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Store the tokens of a sign-in the current user started',
  })
  async complete(
    @Body() body: CompleteOAuth2Dto,
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
  ) {
    const credentialId = await this.oauth2.complete(
      body.code,
      body.state,
      user.id,
    );
    return { success: true, data: { credentialId } };
  }
}

function popupPage(message: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  // "<" escaped so neither value can close the script tag.
  const payload = JSON.stringify(message).replace(/</g, '\\u003c');
  const target = JSON.stringify(frontendOrigin()).replace(/</g, '\\u003c');
  return `<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><script>
  if (window.opener) window.opener.postMessage(${payload}, ${target});
  window.close();
</script><p>You can close this window.</p>`;
}

### AI Output (final_answer)

Ừ, mình nhầm khi cứ bảo bạn gửi log lỗi — bạn nói rõ là **không có lỗi** rồi.

Mình tìm thấy callback Google cũ trả về **một trang chỉ có JavaScript, không có nội dung hiển thị**, nên popup trắng là do cách endpoint được viết. Nhưng việc đó **chưa chứng minh** thông tin Google đã được lưu hay chưa.

Chạy lệnh này để kiểm tra có credential Google mới được tạo không:

```powershell
docker exec flowpilot-postgres psql -U postgres -d flowpilot -c "SELECT cc.id, c.key, cc.name, cc.created_at FROM connector_credentials cc JOIN connectors c ON c.id = cc.connector_id WHERE c.key = 'google' ORDER BY cc.created_at DESC LIMIT 5;"
```

Kết quả sẽ phân biệt được: có dòng mới thì callback đã lưu credential, còn không có thì quá trình OAuth chưa lưu xong.

export function countItems(payload: unknown): number | null {

  return schemaProperties(configSchema) as Record<string, PropertySchema>;
}

// Label of a config field: the schema `title`, else the key without underscores.
export function propertyTitle(key: string, property: PropertySchema): string {
  return typeof property.title === 'string' ? property.title : key.replace(/_/g, ' ');
}

    const credentialId = String(

    res.send(`

### AI Output (commentary)

Database đã xác nhận Google cấp quyền và backend lưu token; mỗi lần thử tạo thêm một credential. Nguyên nhân trong code là callback thành công gọi `window.opener.postMessage(...)` trực tiếp rồi mới đóng popup; nếu trình duyệt không giữ `opener`, lệnh đầu lỗi và popup trắng không đóng. Mình sẽ sửa luồng mở popup để giữ cửa sổ cha, đồng thời cho callback trạng thái hiển thị thay vì trang trắng.

# FlowPilot Frontend Coding Standard (React)

You must follow these rules when developing the frontend:

## 1. Architecture & Organization
- **Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui.
- **Structure**: Feature-Based. Organize code by feature (e.g., `features/workflow/api|components|hooks|pages|store`).
- Components should have one responsibility and ideally be under 200 lines.

## 2. Naming Conventions
- **Components**: PascalCase (`WorkflowCard.tsx`).
- **Hooks**: Prefix with `use` (`useWorkflow.ts`).
- **Services**: camelCase (`workflow.service.ts`).

## 3. Types and State
- **NO `any`**. Use `unknown` or proper interfaces. Prefer `interface` over `type` for models.
- **Local State**: Use `useState` (modals, forms, UI toggles).
- **Global UI State**: Use `Zustand` (theme, sidebar, designer state). NO API data here.
- **Server State**: Use `TanStack React Query` (API data, caching, mutations).

## 4. API & Business Logic
- Components DO NOT call APIs directly. Use React Query hooks which call a service layer.
- Move business logic to services, not components.

## 5. Styling & UI Components (shadcn/ui)
- **Mandatory shadcn/ui**: Always use `shadcn/ui` components (`@/components/ui/*`). Never build raw custom buttons, inputs, dialogs, dropdowns, tables, cards, etc. from scratch.
- **Install missing components**: Run `npx shadcn@latest add <component-name>` inside `frontend/` whenever a UI component is needed and not yet present in `src/components/ui`.
- **Customization**: Extend shadcn components using Tailwind utility classes (`className="..."`) and `cn()` from `@/lib/utils`.
- Follow the color system and theme tokens defined in `src/App.css` and `components.json`.
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useConnector, useCredentials } from '../../hooks/useCredentials';
import { useOAuth2Popup } from '../../hooks/useOAuth2Popup';
import { AddCredentialDialog } from '../AddCredentialDialog';
import { FieldShell } from './FieldShell';

interface CredentialPickerProps {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  // Fixed by the schema (x-connectorKey) or chosen in another field of the node
  // (x-connectorKeyFrom); undefined until that provider is picked.
  connectorKey: string | undefined;
  value: string;
  onChange: (credentialId: string) => void;
}

// Lists only the credentials of the connector and lets the user save a new one.
export function CredentialPicker({
  id,
  label,
  connectorKey,
  value,
  onChange,
}: CredentialPickerProps) {
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const { data: credentials = [], isLoading, isError } = useCredentials(connectorKey);
  const { data: connector } = useConnector(connectorKey);
  // OAuth2 credentials can be signed in again (more Pages, fresh token).
  const reconnect = useOAuth2Popup();

  // A selection that no longer exists (e.g. another provider's) shows as empty.
  const selected = credentials.some((c) => c.id === value) ? value : null;

  const placeholder = isLoading
    ? 'Loading...'
    : isError
      ? 'Could not load saved connections'
      : credentials.length === 0
        ? 'Nothing saved yet'
        : 'Select a connection';

  return (
    <FieldShell
      id={id}
      label={label}
      hint={
        !connectorKey
          ? 'Choose a provider first'
          : isError
            ? 'Saved connections could not be loaded. Check your network and reopen the node.'
            : undefined
      }
    >
      <Select
        value={selected}
        onValueChange={(next) => next !== null && onChange(next)}
        disabled={!connectorKey}
        items={credentials.map((c) => ({ value: c.id, label: c.name }))}
      >
        <SelectTrigger id={id} className="w-full">
          <SelectValue
            placeholder={placeholder}
          />
        </SelectTrigger>
        <SelectContent>
          {credentials.map((credential) => (
            <SelectItem key={credential.id} value={credential.id}>
              {credential.name}
            </SelectItem>
          ))}
        </SelectContent>
      </Select>

      {connectorKey && (
        <>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            className="w-full"
            onClick={() => setDialogOpen(true)}
          >
            + Add connection
          </Button>
          {connector?.oauth2 && selected && (
            <>
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                className="w-full"
                disabled={reconnect.pending}
                onClick={() => void reconnect.connect(selected)}
              >
                {reconnect.pending ? 'Waiting for sign-in...' : 'Reconnect'}
              </Button>
              {reconnect.error && <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{reconnect.error}</p>}
            </>
          )}
          <AddCredentialDialog
            connectorKey={connectorKey}
            open={dialogOpen}
            onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}
            onSaved={onChange}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </FieldShell>
  );
}

interface OAuthFieldProps {
import { Controller, Get, Query, Req, Res, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { QueryBus, CommandBus } from '@nestjs/cqrs';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '@app/auth/infrastructure/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import { GetGoogleAuthUrlQuery } from './application/queries/get-google-auth-url.query';
import { HandleGoogleCallbackCommand } from './application/commands/handle-google-callback.command';

@Controller('api/integrations/google')
export class GoogleOauthController {
  constructor(
    private readonly queryBus: QueryBus,
    private readonly commandBus: CommandBus,
  ) {}

  @Get('auth')
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
  async auth(@Req() req: Request & { user?: { id?: string } }) {
    const userId = req.user?.id || 'unknown';

    const url = String(
      await this.queryBus.execute(new GetGoogleAuthUrlQuery(userId)),
    );

    return { url };
  }

  @Get('callback')
  async callback(
    @Query('code') code: string,
    @Query('state') state: string,
    @Res() res: Response,
  ) {
    if (!code || !state) {
      return res.status(400).send('Code or state is missing');
    }

    const credentialId = String(
      await this.commandBus.execute(
        new HandleGoogleCallbackCommand(code, state),
      ),
    );

    res.send(`
      <script>
        window.opener.postMessage({ type: 'oauth-success', credentialId: '${credentialId}' }, '*');
        window.close();
      </script>
    `);
  }
}

    feat: Messenger trigger and reply node (chat-trigger P2)
    
    A customer message to a connected Facebook Page now starts the workflow,
    and the workflow can answer on Messenger:
    
    - messenger connector (Page ID + Page Access Token typed in a form);
      credentials accept { name, secret } validated by the connector schema,
      { name, api_key } still works
    - trigger.messenger.message: publishing listens on the Page id of the
      credential; GET /api/webhooks/messenger answers Meta's verification,
      POST checks X-Hub-Signature-256 on the raw body, drops echoes and
      deliveries, runs each message once (dedup by message id) in the queue
    - integration.messenger.send: Graph API send with retries for rate
      limits and outages, clear errors for the 24-hour window and bad tokens
    - publish is blocked when the Page already feeds another workflow
    - frontend: credential dialog built from the connector schema
    - scripts/simulate-messenger-webhook.mjs and docs/setup/messenger.md

diff --git a/frontend/src/features/workflow/hooks/useOAuth2Popup.ts b/frontend/src/features/workflow/hooks/useOAuth2Popup.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..fc7e930
--- /dev/null
+++ b/frontend/src/features/workflow/hooks/useOAuth2Popup.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
+import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
+import { errorMessage, triggerService } from '../services/trigger.service';
+import { credentialKeys } from './useCredentials';
+
+interface CallbackMessage {
+  type?: unknown;
+  status?: unknown;
+  credentialId?: unknown;
+  message?: unknown;
+}
+
+// Connects an OAuth2 credential in a pop-up. The callback page posts
+// { type: 'oauth2-callback', status, credentialId | message } and closes.
+export function useOAuth2Popup(onConnected?: (credentialId: string) => void) {
+  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
+  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
+  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const waitingFor = useRef<string | null>(null);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const handle = (event: MessageEvent<CallbackMessage>) => {
+      if (event.data?.type !== 'oauth2-callback' || !waitingFor.current) return;
+      waitingFor.current = null;
+      setPending(false);
+      if (event.data.status === 'success' && typeof event.data.credentialId === 'string') {
+        setError(null);
+        void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: credentialKeys.all });
+        void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['node-options'] });
+        onConnected?.(event.data.credentialId);
+      } else {
+        setError(typeof event.data.message === 'string' ? event.data.message : 'Sign-in failed');
+      }
+    };
+    window.addEventListener('message', handle);
+    return () => window.removeEventListener('message', handle);
+  }, [onConnected, queryClient]);
+
+  const connect = useCallback(async (credentialId: string) => {
+    setError(null);
+    setPending(true);
+    waitingFor.current = credentialId;
+    // Opened before the request so pop-up blockers allow it.
+    const popup = window.open('', 'oauth2', 'width=600,height=700');
+    try {
+      const url = await triggerService.oauth2Url(credentialId);
+      if (popup) popup.location.href = url;
+      else window.open(url, 'oauth2', 'width=600,height=700');
+      // Closing the pop-up without finishing must not leave the button waiting.
+      const watch = window.setInterval(() => {
+        if (!popup || popup.closed) {
+          window.clearInterval(watch);
+          setPending(false);
+        }
+      }, 500);
+    } catch (cause) {
+      popup?.close();
+      waitingFor.current = null;
+      setPending(false);
+      setError(errorMessage(cause, 'Sign-in could not start'));
+    }
+  }, []);
+
+  return { connect, pending, error };
+}

+// Address outside callers (webhooks, OAuth redirects) use; falls back to the
+// local server.
+export function publicBaseUrl(): string {
+  const configured = process.env['PUBLIC_BASE_URL']?.trim();
+  if (configured) return configured.replace(/\/+$/, '');
+  return `http://localhost:${process.env['PORT'] ?? 8080}`;
+}
+
+export function webhookUrl(endpointId: string): string {
+  return `${publicBaseUrl()}/api/webhooks/${endpointId}`;
+}
+
+export function oauth2RedirectUrl(): string {
+  return `${publicBaseUrl()}/api/oauth2/callback`;
+}
